name: Paradigm of Lust
description: Enemies targeting a nearby spouse are [effect:scorn][dark-gray]scorned[/dark-gray][/effect], letting you lunge at them from afar, [dark-red]but[/dark-red] if a spouse dies in combat you wither away unless you enact [effect:vengeance][dark-gray]reckless vengeance[/dark-gray][/effect] against their killer.

effects.label: Versus scorned targets:
effects.explanation:
- Swing at them while within 32 blocks to lunge.
- Your first strike sates 1 hunger and grants 50% attack speed for 7 seconds.
- Your strikes heal the targeted spouse for 15% of damage dealt.
Gain +20% speed toward your vengeance target. You can only have one vengeance target at a time. The wither is only cleansed upon killing your target.
